name: gliner2-chain-m1m6-v1
status: development-frozen experiment chain; NOT active in production; not a generalization proof
scope: Frozen combination of the M1-M6 post-processing and contract improvements measured on the blindtest v2 diagnostic development set (16 cases). This manifest is the reference for the next independent blind test: the whole chain must run unchanged on new unseen documents.

prompt_versions.recovery_question: supplementary assessment; states the need's operational role and asks whether the span itself expresses the requested value

chain_order: context: clause; PARTY needs use the M4 structural window (block + heading, max 8 lines per direction, boundaries at blank line/page marker/heading)
candidate generation: frozen GLiNER2 candidates (no new model inference in M1-M6 arms)
M1 presentation normalization: collapse whitespace; repair a space after a hyphen inside a date token; despace(original)==despace(normalized); original hash + clause offsets kept
M2 span-boundary consolidation: drop a candidate only when its canonical form is a strict substring of a longer span in the same case; no proximity merges
M3 role robustness: declared need role breaks a role tie only when its cue occurs in the span's sentence (word-boundary + common Swedish inflection suffixes)

M6 selective recovery: exactly one supplementary assessment for a first NO when the span is a candidate, a deterministic detector recognises a value of the need's type, the operational role matches, and the first answer was NO; recovered answers enter the ordinary contract
M5 cardinality: SINGLE unchanged; MULTIPLE (expected_count from facit; resolved only when all expected values verified, no extras) with explicit PARTIAL; UNKNOWN never resolves from values alone
assessment/usage: no automatic RESOLVED; normal evidence-quality and assessment contract applies

rules.M1: presentation-only; no canonical content change; provenance (original hash + clause offsets) retained
rules.M2: strict canonical containment inside the same case; no proximity heuristic
rules.M3: declared-role tie-break only; classifier role stands when the declared cue is absent
rules.M4: PARTY needs only; structural block + heading; max 8 lines per direction; blank line/page marker/heading boundaries; no arbitrary char count
rules.M5: need-level cardinality (not a party special case); expected_count from facit, never from verified candidates; found != complete; UNKNOWN requires a completeness result
rules.M6: one supplementary assessment per triggered candidate NO; three guards: no blind re-review, single supplementary, no automatic RESOLVED

cost_definitions.execution_jev_calls: verification decisions the strategy performs from an empty cache, including supplementary recovery calls
cost_definitions.experiment_new_calls: JEV calls actually made beyond frozen fixtures; never used as the strategy's cost

measured_on.dataset: blindtest v2 diagnostic development set, 16 needs / 3 unseen contracts
measured_on.frozen_chain: M1-M6 accumulated: 15/16 solved, 1 PARTIAL, 27 execution JEV calls, 0 false RESOLVED, 0 clause-level contamination, 0 model inferences in the post-processing arms

known_limits: the 16 cases developed M1-M6; the result is not a generalization proof
v2-pm-07 remains PARTIAL: the second party is never proposed by GLiNER2 (candidate-generation gap, not verification)
M5 UNKNOWN cardinality is implemented and conformance-tested synthetically but has no real case in v2
D10 answer-level contamination has not been run on the improved chain; only a clause-level proxy exists
answer-level correctness must be measured separately from clause resolution
next_step: Independent blind test on entirely new documents: frozen original chain vs frozen M1-M6 chain, no adjustments; include simple and hard needs and multi-value needs with UNKNOWN cardinality; run real D10 at answer level.
